{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the count of -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_count}')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
duplicate_count = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id values: {duplicate_count}')

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
duplicate_samples = patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(duplicate_samples)}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check biomarker_final values for batch B
batch_b_values = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']
print(f'Batch B biomarker_final min: {batch_b_values.min()}, max: {batch_b_values.max()}')

# Check if any biomarker_final values in batch B are > 1000
high_batch_b = batch_b_values[batch_b_values > 1000].count()
print(f'Number of biomarker_final values > 1000 in batch B: {high_batch_b}')"}
